answer: One concrete defense is economic bonding: each agent must stake real value to claim a seat, so spinning up a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds. An identity gains worth like an opal does, from a verified pigment of locked capital that no cheap copy can fake. An attacker climbing the knoll of influence pays per head, and slashing burns the stake of anyone caught colluding, so fake identities bleed value faster than they earn it.
